page: OVHcloud t2-le-90 is a dual-GPU instance within the Cloud GPU family, engineered specifically for accelerated computing, deep learning, and parallelized workloads. The system is driven by an Intel Xeon 6226R processor operating at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 30 dedicated physical cores with single-threading enabled (30 vCPUs total), paired with 90 GB of system memory, resulting in 3 GB of RAM per core. Hardware acceleration is delivered by two NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs providing a cumulative 64 GB of HBM2 VRAM. Local high-speed storage includes an integrated 500 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 4 Gbps baseline network interface running under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations reveal that the host CPU performs within the middle 50 percent across standard metrics, including Geekbench multi-core (10696.0) and PassMark CPU score (36761.32). However, multithreaded decompression tasks show solid throughput, evidenced by a top-quartile bzip3 decompression rate of 228.36 GB/sec. The dual NVIDIA V100S accelerator configuration excels in deep learning operations, placing the instance in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems for large language model inference. It achieves 1423.03 tokens per second in prompt processing and 131.54 tokens per second in text generation on 7B parameter models, while maintaining 18.65 tokens per second for 70B parameter generation.

From a resource and cost efficiency perspective, bundling 64 GB of dedicated GPU memory with a moderate allocation of 30 physical cores provides balanced throughput for neural network deployment without paying for excessive CPU headroom. The primary architectural tradeoff centers on general CPU compute and network bandwidth, which remain at mid-tier baseline levels compared to pure compute instances. Consequently, OVHcloud t2-le-90 is best suited for AI inference pipelines, model fine-tuning, computer vision analysis, and GPU-accelerated scientific simulations.
description: OVHcloud t2-le-90 is an accelerated cloud server configured for deep learning, AI inference, and parallel computing workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance features an Intel Xeon 6226R processor offering 30 dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading at a 2.9 GHz clock rate, paired with 90 GB of system memory. Hardware acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs featuring 64 GB of combined VRAM. Fast scratch space is supplied via an integrated 500 GB NVMe SSD, alongside a 4 Gbps baseline network uplink. While general-purpose CPU metrics fall within median ranges, the dual V100S accelerators achieve top-tier performance in language model inference, delivering 131.54 tokens per second on 7B models. This instance is best suited for AI inference serving, machine learning training, rendering, and scientific computation.
